metadata.title: Braid Stability and a Floer theory of Braid Isotopies
metadata.abstract: We build a Floer theory on the space of braids of periodic orbits of a Hamiltonian flow on a closed symplectic surface. The differential and continuation maps are defined by counting Floer isotopies of braids: tuples of Floer cylinders with pairwise disjoint graphs. With this new perspective, we prove a quantitative braid stability result that shows the persistence of braids under possibly large Hamiltonian perturbations. As an application, we show that for every $\alpha\geq 0$ there is a sequence of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms $\phi_k$ on the two-torus $T^2$ such that $$d_H(\operatorname{Ent}_{\leq \alpha}(T^2,\omega),\phi_k)\to \infty \quad (k \to \infty),$$ where $\text{Ent}_{\leq \alpha}(T^2,\omega)\subset \text{Ham}(T^2,\omega)$ denotes the set of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms with topological entropy at most $\alpha$ and $d_H$ the Hofer metric. We prove this result by studying only contractible periodic orbits, whereas analogous higher-genus statements were previously obtained using non-contractible orbits.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 辫同伦 Floer 理论与稳定性
analysis.workSummary: 对闭辛曲面 Hamilton 流的周期轨道辫，以图两两不交的 Floer 圆柱元组定义微分和延拓；得到大扰动下辫持续性，并在 T2 上构造距有界熵集合 Hofer 距离无界的序列。
analysis.breakthrough: 仅用可缩周期轨道即可获得环面上的定量熵分离。
analysis.limitations: 计数的紧性、横截性和不交条件是新理论核心，需重点读。 已补读主结果和方法片段，未独立验证整篇证明；AI 披露另行做独立全文核查，尚未核验的记录不代表未使用 AI。 已读定理 A 与定量辫稳定性定义：Floer isotopy 的圆柱图两两不交，对其能量作 action 估计；不同于单独计算 Floer 圆柱，关键约束是多股的持续不交。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者仅披露使用 Claude 查找排字错误及核验第 5.3 节计算。
analysis.aiEvidenceSource: https://arxiv.org/pdf/2609.34961v1 · 第 8 页 AI Acknowledgment

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者仅披露使用 Claude 查找排字错误及核验第 5.3 节计算。

analysis.priorityReason: 对辛动力学稳定性与度量复杂度有结构性意义。
